title: Sales manager creates a product: an empty save is refused, a valid product is listed with its unit

seeds.name: unitName
seeds.sql: SELECT u.Name AS k FROM Products.UoM AS u WHERE u.Name = 'Units'

steps.name: New product, Save with every field empty: refused, message shown, nothing stored
Fill name, unit and price and save: back on the list with the product shown

oql.label: the purchase unit defaults to the sales unit
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(p.ID) AS n FROM Products.Product AS p WHERE p.Name = 'Journey Chair' AND p/Products.Product_PurchaseUoM/Products.UoM/Name = 'Units'

outcome.label: the product is sellable at 120 per unit
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(p.ID) AS n FROM Products.Product AS p WHERE p.Name = 'Journey Chair' AND p.SalesPrice = 120 AND p.Active = true
